question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

My friend has been a teacher **__since 10 years__**.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "for 10 years."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence **"My friend has been a teacher since 10 years"** lies in the use of the preposition **"since"** with the duration of time.
 
• This change ensures that the correct preposition is used to indicate the duration of time.
 
• Using **"since"** in this context would imply a specific point in time when your friend became a teacher, which may not be the intended meaning.
 
 
• **Example**: *I have been working at the company for five years **since**__ I graduated from college.*
 
 
 
• Instead, **"for"** is used to indicate the duration of time your friend has been a teacher.
 __
 
• **Example**: *She has been studying French **for**__ six months to prepare for her upcoming trip to Paris.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence:* My friend has been a teacher__** for 10 years**__.*
